skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Inviting Snow
skins.content: Harold's home attire/Inviting Snow. A burdenbeast neck pillow, burdenbeast pajamas, burdenbeast slippers. A full burdenbeast ensemble, very popular in Kjerag right now!
skins.quote: In times like these, when ice and snow rage outside the window, you should get a cup of hot cocoa, write love-filled letters to your wife and daughter, and throw in a comment on how cute the souvenir pajamas you gave them are. In short, he is rather pleased with himself.
